name: Ringstep
description: Three rings of increasing weight, each one further out than the last.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 22%, #000 22% 27%, transparent 27% 48%, #000 48% 58%, transparent 58% 78%, #000 78% 94%, transparent 94%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 22%, #000 22% 27%, transparent 27% 48%, #000 48% 58%, transparent 58% 78%, #000 78% 94%, transparent 94%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
